paper.title: Annealed Softmax Greedy in Many-Armed Bayesian Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Many-armed Bayesian Bernoulli bandit with 1-regular (linear upper tail) prior
unmapped: Arm means drawn i.i.d. from a prior Gamma on [0,1] that is beta-regular near 1 (c0 eps^beta <= Gamma([1-eps,1]) <= C0 eps^beta); main result for beta = 1
Many-armed regime: number of arms m may scale with T (e.g. m = Theta(sqrt T))
settings.definition_quote: Fix a time horizon $T\in\mathbb{N}$ and consider $m\in\mathbb{N}$ arms indexed by $i\in[m]$. Each arm has an unknown mean $\mu_i\in[0,1]$ drawn i.i.d. from a prior $\Gamma$ on $[0,1]$. Conditional on $\mu_i$, each arm $i$ has an i.i.d. sequence of Bernoulli rewards ... Throughout the paper we assume $T \ge m$.

bound.expression: K + T*delta_thr + K*(1 + log(1/delta_thr)) + L_leak/delta_thr + T*exp(-c_alg*K*delta_thr)

symbols.delta_thr: threshold parameter delta in (0, delta_0] of the analysis/schedule
symbols.L_leak: softmax leakage sum_{t=1}^T exp(-eta_t * delta_thr) for the inverse-temperature schedule eta_t
symbols.c_alg: constant c>0 depending only on prior regularity constants and Bernoulli crossing constant

conditions: prior Gamma is 1-regular with constants (c0, C0, eps0)
tuning: delta in (0, delta_0] with delta_0 <= min{1/8, eps0/8}

source.label: thm:asg-beta1
source.quote:
Then there exist constants $c,C>0$ (depending only on $c_0, C_0, \varepsilon_0$ and on the Bernoulli crossing constant in Lemma~\ref{lem:bern-cross}) such that
\begin{align}
\mathrm{BR}_{T,m}(\text{ASG})
\ &\le\ C\Bigg[
m
\ +\ T\,\delta
\ +\ m\bigl(1+\log(1/\delta)\bigr)
\ +\frac{1}{\delta}\sum_{t=1}^T \exp(-\eta_t\,\delta)
\ +\ T\,\exp(-c\,m\,\delta)
\Bigg].\label{eq:asg-main-bound}
\end{align}

results.notes: K = m (number of arms). Bayes regret over prior, rewards and policy randomness. Constant C depends on prior regularity constants.

tuning: delta = min{delta_0, A log(T v 2)/m} with A > 1/c

source.label: thm:asg-beta1
source.quote:
In particular, choosing
\begin{equation}\label{eq:delta-choice-beta1}
\delta \ =\ \min\!\left\{\delta_0,\, A\frac{\log(T\vee 2)}{m}\right\},
\qquad
\eta_t \ =\ \frac{c_\eta}{\delta}\log(t\vee 2)\quad(c_\eta>1),
\end{equation}
with $A > 1/c$, we have
\[
\mathrm{BR}_{T,m}(\text{ASG}) \ =\ \tilde{O}\!\left(m+\frac{T}{m}\right)\,,
\]
and for $m=\Theta(\sqrt{T})$ one obtains $\mathrm{BR}_{T,m}(\text{ASG})=\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$.

results.notes: Remark 5.3 sketches a general-beta extension O~(m + T(log T/m)^{1/beta}) for beta>=1 without a formal proof; not recorded.

tuning: delta = min{delta_0, A log(T v 2)/m} with A > 1/c
results.notes: Specialization of r2 with m = Theta(sqrt T).
